Nora (CS): Dropping a micro SOP we used today for a risky renewal demo: 1) flip 'prefill' 3m prior, 2) stream with 2-token heartbeat, 3) tenant cache 60s with regional fallback. Short & repeatable.

Diego (SRE): Good. Ops notes: cap concurrent prefill jobs per-region to 8; emit prefill.jobs.failed. Add alert if failures >3 in 10m.

Mina (Eng): Add personalization detector: if system_prompt_tokens > 180 OR dynamic_vars > 4 -> allocate warm-pool (5-10m) instead of tenant-cache.

Cal (Solutions): Sample prefill payload we left in the pilot:
POST /v1/prefill/run
{ tenant: "acct-555", queries: ["status","refund","onboard"], parallel:2, sanitized:false }
Works well with parallel=2.

Acme-PM: Confirmed demo was smoother. One challenge: PII-sensitive orgs need sanitized mode.

Nora (CS): Checklist for modal: Toggle prefill 3m before, pin model, check prefill.hit_ratio > 70% tile, if <50% -> fallback to streaming-only + ping #customer-success-escalations. Post-demo: 1-q pulse (snappy? y/n).

Diego (SRE): I'll add metrics: prefill.hit_count, miss_count, job_latency (tags: tenant, region, sanitized).

Mina (Eng): I'll add rate-limit + warm-pool API. PR incoming.

Nora (CS): Thanks — will update the runbook and run with 6 more accounts this week.
